12.t: Working with data: water in and out
q: How much water was lost as sweat on the hot day?
Calculate the total water gained on the cool day.
Calculate the urine on the hot day if water in = water out.
In: 3700 mL. Out except urine: 2600. Urine = 1100 mL.
Explain how the kidneys made less urine on the hot day.
Sweating made the blood more concentrated; the brain released more ADH, so the kidneys reabsorbed more water, making less, darker urine.
